name: Private endpoint
summary: Private endpoint that gives a PaaS resource a private IP in your virtual network, with optional private DNS registration.
useWhen: You need private connectivity to a PaaS resource that has no built-in private endpoint option in its own module
You want to add a private endpoint to an existing resource
avoidWhen: The resource module already has privateEndpointSubnetResourceId (storage account, Foundry, app service): use that instead
